title: Salt Moon
one_line: A girl on a salt moon learns the light her station trusts is counting them, and helps her mother switch it off.
setting: A mining station on a salt moon, under one light that is its only line to the company that owns it.

cast.name: Tamsin Dray
cast.personality: Curious and stubborn, she asks the question everyone else has stopped asking. She protects her brother before herself.
cast.write_up: Tamsin grows up on Brine Station under the Lantern. She hides a stranger, follows his warning into the station's files and learns the light is counting them. She chooses to stay and help switch it off.

sections.summary: The Brine Bell rings early. The Drays at supper; the debt is growing; the Lantern blinks above.
Tamsin walks the flats on a tether and finds a stranger's prints. She first thinks she could leave.
She finds Quill Asher hiding in the pump house and hides him.
The Lantern goes dark. Halden promises help; Mira holds a badge with another name.
The files show the Lantern is a meter. Halden says Mira helped write it.
Pell's map shows every channel runs to the dome that powers the Lantern.
At low tide Tamsin swims under the gate and finds Mira cutting the meter loose.
The Lantern comes back white. Quill leaves; Tamsin chooses to stay.

point.note: Tamsin Dray first comes in here.

proof.detail: short dark hair cut with a knife
proof.quote: Her hair was short and dark, cut with the same knife she used on the tether knots.
her boots were white to the ankle with salt
the scar across her chin pulled tight when she grinned
a girl of fourteen who knew every pump by its cough
